# num-bigint

The runtime uses num-bigint 0.4.8 with fallible left-shift allocation. The
crate source, original manifest, README, and licenses come from upstream
revision `65330056d6c00def4c6cda78c87453f4c2a76913`. The registry archive
has SHA-256 `c89e69e7e0f03bea5ef08013795c25018e101932225a656383bd384495ecc367`.

The local change is confined to `num-bigint/src/biguint/shift.rs`.
